rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
ω = (μv − μr)/(μd − 1)
Power of achromatic combination → 0 net dispersion

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Measure of dispersion: standard deviation" as one blob → ✅ split into: measure of dispersion: standard deviation, variance, coefficient of variation.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Dispersive power ω = (μv − μr)/(μd − 1); angular dispersion ΔD ∝ ω for a given refractive index.  ·  Achromatism: net deviation of two cemented prisms is zero for a chosen colour → (ω₁/ω₂) relations on D/(μ−1).
